svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — single-model leaderboard
svg.desc: Thirteen single-model settings, six cloud APIs and seven self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 1–5 seconds; one recorded pass per setting.
svg.text: Normalized log-AUC over 1–5 s · Higher is better
